title: Events, Errors, and External Calls
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Events, Errors, and External Calls.
learning_objectives: Explain events, errors, and external calls using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for events, errors, and external calls
Assess failure and operational limits of events, errors, and external calls
concepts_covered: Events are receipts for off-chain tools; custom errors make failed operations more specific.
Contracts emit funding, dispute, settlement, credit, withdrawal, mint, audit, and royalty events and define typed errors.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
